items.title: Proper pushforward of cycle and Chow groups commutes with the base change pullback in the shifted degrees
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: In the base change situation, for a composite Y -> X -> S locally of finite type with base change Y' -> X' -> S' and f : Y -> X proper, the lemma asserts that f' is proper and that the two diagrams of cycle groups Z_k(Y) -> Z_k(X) -> Z_{k+c}(X') and of Chow groups commute with the pullback g^* (statement lines 15339-15360). The proof reduces to the level of cycles and to a single integral closed subscheme Z of Y of dimension k: by construction g^*[Z] = [Z']_{k+c}, and then both routes are computed by pushing forward the structure sheaf, using that f_*[Z] = [f_*O_Z]_k and (f')_*g^*[Z] = [f'_*O_{Z'}]_{k+c} and that g^*f_*[Z] = [(X' -> X)^* f_*O_Z]_{k+c} (proof lines 15363-15371). The whole reduction therefore turns on the isomorphism (X' -> X)^* f_*O_Z = f'_*O_{Z'} of coherent modules on X', which holds by flat base change because X' -> X is flat and O_{Z'} = (Y' -> Y)^*O_Z (proof lines 15372-15378). Reducing a commuting diagram of Chow groups to a single application of flat base change for coherent sheaves is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
